# Functions
```{r functions}

movingAverage <- function(x, n=1, centered=FALSE) 
{	if (centered) {
        before <- floor  ((n-1)/2)
        after  <- ceiling((n-1)/2)
    } else {
        before <- n-1
        after  <- 0
    }
    s     <- rep(0, length(x))
    count <- rep(0, length(x))
	new <- x
    count <- count + !is.na(new)
    new[is.na(new)] <- 0
    s <- s + new
	i <- 1
    while (i <= before) {
        new   <- c(rep(NA, i), x[1:(length(x)-i)])
		count <- count + !is.na(new)
        new[is.na(new)] <- 0
        s <- s + new
        i <- i+1
    }
    i <- 1
    while (i <= after) {
        new   <- c(x[(i+1):length(x)], rep(NA, i))
        count <- count + !is.na(new)
        new[is.na(new)] <- 0
        s <- s + new
        i <- i+1
    }
    s/count
}
```


# Loading Metadata 
```{r load metadata}
# Read the mapping file
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("Data", "ESA_coral_data_entry_2026-Collections.csv"), check.names = F)
sample_metadata$Site <- substr(sample_metadata$Site, nchar(sample_metadata$Site)-1, nchar(sample_metadata$Site))
sample_metadata$Site <- as.integer(sample_metadata$Site)
sample_metadata<- sample_metadata[,-15]

mapplist <- read.csv(here("Data", "MAPP_Metadata-Sheet1.csv"), check.names = F)
colnames(sample_metadata)[13] <- 'Bag_number'
metadata <- sample_metadata %>% full_join(mapplist)

#metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::filter(!(is.na(Sophie)))
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(`CBASS / Sophie` == "CBASS") #only analyze data here from experiment
sample_metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    UniqueID = paste0('t', Site, "_", Species, Genotype),
    UniqueID = tolower(trimws(UniqueID))
  )

colnames(sample_metadata)[21] <- 'CoralID'
sample_metadata$CoralID <- tolower(sample_metadata$CoralID)
write.csv(sample_metadata,  here ("Data", "AS26_MAPPmetadata.csv"), row.names = F)

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  mutate(UniqueID = case_when(
    Date != '20260211'  & Project == 'ESA' ~ paste0('t', Site, "_", CoralID),
    Date != '20260211' & Project == 'OCC' ~ paste0('occ', Site, "_", CoralID),
    TRUE ~ CoralID
  ))
```
# Phenotyping
### Load and Compile Processed Phenotype Data
```{r compiling processed pheno}
###### compiling all photophys to one csv ################# 
# Set the directory containing your data files
#data_dir <- 'Data/alldatacomparison/All_Phenotyping_Data/Processed/'
data_dir <- here("Data/phenotyping_data/normalized")

# Get a list of all files in the directory
#file_list <- list.files(path = data_dir, full.names = TRUE)
file_list <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "^[^aoiAOI]" ) #excluding the duplicated files here and the OCC ones. only want CBASS at this time

# Initialize an empty list to store data frames
photophys <- list()
data <- read.csv(file_list[1])
photophys <- data[,2:6]
mapplist <- list()

# Loop through each file, read it, and store it in the list
for (file in file_list) {
  # Read the file 
  data <- read.csv(file)
  #base_sample_id <- substr(path_file(file), 1, nchar(path_file(file)) - 18)
  base_sample_id <- path_file(file) %>%
  sub("\\.csv$", "", .) %>%        # remove file extension
  sub("\\._\\d+r$", "", .) %>%     # remove ._02r, ._05r etc
  tolower() %>%
  trimws()
  mapp_no <- substr(path_file(file), nchar(path_file(file)) - 16, nchar(path_file(file)) - 14)
# CREATE A UNIQUE KEY (e.g., "Sample123_M01")
  #unique_key <- paste0(base_sample_id, "_", mapp_no)
unique_key <- paste0(base_sample_id)
  # Store using the unique key
  photophys[[unique_key]] <- data[, 7]
  #mapplist[[unique_key]] <- mapp_no
}

# Convert mapp_list to a dataframe as you did before
mapplist_df <- data.frame(
  SampleID = names(mapplist),
  mapp_no = as.numeric(unlist(mapplist)),
  # Use regex to pull the original CoralID back out if needed
  UniqueID = sub("_[^_]+$", "", names(mapplist)), 
 # UniqueID = names(mapplist),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# mapplist_df <- mapplist_df %>% 
#   mutate( CoralID = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)", "\\1", SampleID))
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>% full_join(mapplist_df, by = 'UniqueID')
```

```{r compiling processed pheno}
#this is written by gemini
#now read in the reference photophys from Fiji


folders <- c(
  here("Data", "phenotyping_data", "fiji", "ad_c"),
  here("Data", "phenotyping_data", "fiji", "ah_c"),
  here("Data", "phenotyping_data", "fiji", "pver_d")
)

# Initialize an empty list to store data frames temporarily
df_list <- list()
metadata_initialized <- FALSE
photophys_external <- data.frame()

# 2. Wrap the file processing inside a loop that iterates through your folders
for (folder in folders) {
  
  # Get full paths to the CSV files in this specific folder
  files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  cat(basename(folder), ":", length(files), "files\n")
  
  for (file in files) {
    dat <- read.csv(file)
    
    # Initialize metadata columns only once using the very first file found
    if (!metadata_initialized) {
      photophys_external <- dat[, 1:6]
      metadata_initialized <- TRUE
    }
    
    # Extract the sample name to use as the column header
    sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    
    # Append the 6th column to our dataframe
    photophys_external[[sample_name]] <- dat[, 6]
  }
}

# Check the final dimensions
print(dim(photophys_external))

photophys_external <- as.data.frame(photophys_external)

dim(photophys_external)
 head(colnames(photophys_external))

#rename
 ref_cols <- setdiff(
  names(photophys_external),
  c("uni", "metric", "metrix", "stage", "col")
)
 
 # 2. Rename only the sample columns with the "REF_" prefix
names(photophys_external)[names(photophys_external) %in% ref_cols] <- paste0("REF_", ref_cols)

# 3. Check if 'col' actually exists before trying to merge
if (!"col" %in% names(photophys_external)) {
  stop("Stop! 'photophys_external' is still missing the 'col' column. Check your data loading step.")
}

# 4. Use left_join instead of cbind for a bulletproof merge
# This uses the metadata columns as keys to perfectly align rows
photophys_combined <- left_join(
  photophys,
  photophys_external,
  by = c("uni", "metric", "metrix", "stage", "col")
)

# Verify the result
dim(photophys_combined)
```
